items.title: Twisting by the pullback of the tautological bundle kills the higher direct images along the projection of a closed subspace of projective space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that twisting a coherent module on a closed subspace of projective space by powers of the pulled back tautological bundle kills all higher direct images along the projection once the power is large enough (statement lines 3808-3823). The proof uses the etale local character of the vanishing to reduce to a Noetherian affine base, where the subspace becomes a scheme, and then quotes the scheme case. The reduction to the scheme situation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
